info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Update Loan Details API
info.description: The Update Loan Details API allows authorized users to modify existing loan information within the system. This operation is essential for maintaining accurate loan records, enabling businesses to adjust terms, interest rates, or other key attributes as needed. Typically used by financial institutions and customer service representatives, this API supports the dynamic management of loans, ensuring clients receive up-to-date information. The API facilitates improvements in user experience and operational efficiency by streamlining the loan management process.

put.description: This endpoint allows users to update the details of a specified loan using its unique identifier. Ensure that all required fields are included and properly formatted.

requestBody.description: Updates the specified loan with the provided details. Ensure that all required fields are included in the request body to successfully process the update.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the resource has been updated.
